description: Prove. Call this when you hold a receipt number or id (rc_… or pm_…) for a check and need the record that it was made: the receipt, its hash, its signature and its place in the chain, checked in public. This is the receipts door at rco.wefetch.ai, answered here under its own name. To have a receipt written, pass receipt: true on fetch_gtin, locate or identify (issue_receipt: true on match_product).
name: verify_receipt
title: Prove: check a receipt
